provisional_findings.note_on_overlap: The three aggregate groups are mutually exclusive; they are descriptive engineering triage, not an acceptance ranking.
provisional_findings.strongest_mechanism: Reference-conditioned built-in ImageGen with explicit hair/wardrobe invariants and panel-specific causal composition, paired with text-only controls when orientation flexibility matters.
provisional_findings.strongest_style_route: Use clear-line watercolor or clean graphic for action/reveal anchors, cel-painted close panels for face continuity, and a genuinely simplified limited-ink arm for dialogue and inserts.
provisional_findings.cadence_recommendation: Alternate wide action/reveal anchors with medium character deductions, tall transitions, and small causal inserts; do not force a single ratio or density across the chapter.
limitations: The built-in tool did not disclose model, endpoint, provider request ID, usage, or cost.
No deterministic seed or exact rerun contract was available.
